title: 2022 USAMO Problem 5
statement:
A function \(f: \mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}\) is \(\textit{essentially increasing}\) if \(f(s)\leq f(t)\) holds whenever \(s\leq t\) are real numbers such that \(f(s)\neq 0\) and \(f(t)\neq 0\).

Find the smallest integer \(k\) such that for any 2022 real numbers \(x_1,x_2,\ldots , x_{2022},\) there exist \(k\) essentially increasing functions \(f_1,\ldots, f_k\) such that

\[
f_1(n) + f_2(n) + \cdots + f_k(n) = x_n\qquad \text{for every } n= 1,2,\ldots 2022.
\]
